items.title: Nat Hentoff interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming in Manhattan for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. It’s a real pleasure for me to have Nat Hentoff with me today

ctx.x: NEA Jazz Master (2004) Nat Hentoff has made his mark in the jazz world as an author, record producer, editor and confidant of countless musicians. He is an astute observer of American culture and politics and writes for The Village Voice, The Wall Street Journal and Jazz Times.
Nat was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming in Manhattan for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. It’s a real pleasure for me to have Nat Hentoff with me today, one of our most vigilant writers and observers of American culture I think I can safely say.
